purpose: Run one explicitly fuel-bounded proof search and package its successful result with a checked derivation, while preserving that this is not an unbounded theoremhood decision.

input.type_ref: searchK (suc zero) for the fixed K-formula
input.available_information: one unit of fuel and the finite candidate space

environment.theory_model: search success is paired with a derivation

observation.value: search success plus a proof of the target formula
observation.trace: execute at one fuel, validate found result, package both

time_structure.temporal_order: search runs before its result is checked

quantifiers.instances: one fixed formula and one fixed fuel

allowed_resources: one fuel and the fixed candidate
prohibited_extra_information: no unbounded completeness, theoremhood decision or all-truth claim
assumptions: the finite search space contains the K candidate
obligations: the result must contain both execution and sound derivation
zero fuel must be rejected as success

known_positive_controls.description: one fuel reports success and decodes to the K derivation

correspondence.original_activity: find a proof within one declared search step
changed_fields: unbounded proof search is deliberately outside the task
correspondence.observation_justification: fuel and result pair are declared before search
correspondence.reality_bridge_detail: The explicit fuel blocks any inference to unbounded proof search.
